summary: basestring is gone in Python 3; use string_types, binary_type or text_type from ansible.module_utils.six, or to_text/to_bytes/to_native for conversions.
questions: What replaces basestring in Ansible code?
How do I convert values to text in a module?

answer_card.title: no-basestring test
answer_card.answer_md: Use `isinstance(s, string_types)` or `isinstance(s, (binary_type, text_type))` from `ansible.module_utils.six`. For conversions, `ansible.module_utils.common.text.converters` provides `to_text`, `to_bytes`, `to_native`.
